text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski will present Macedonia's political and economic situation at the Crans Montana economic forum on Friday. On Saturday he will speak on the subject securty in Southeast Europe.
- Droughts have caused damages worth up to six million German marks to the agricultural cooperative Pelagonija.
- Internal debt of 6,800 Macedonian companies is 18 billion denars (23 million German marks).

- An international auditing company determined a loss of 23 million German marks in the municipality of Skopje. The public prosecutor is expected to file charges against the former municipal officials for mismanagement.

- According to foreign ministry sources Macedonia has made a written proposal for the settlement of its dispute with Greece over its name according to which the name Republic of Macedonia would be used internationally and another name, to be agreed on, in bilateral contacts.

- Macedonian foreign ministry sources deny Krivolak was offered to the United States as a miilitary base and that its use as a military test range is being considered. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
